title: DNA Quantification Using the Quantus Fluorometer
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7pzhmp6

steps.title: Prepare sample tubes
steps.instruction: Set up the required number of 0.5 mL thin‑wall, clear PCR tubes (e.g., Axygen #PCR‑05‑C) and label the lids only, avoiding any markings on the tube sides.

steps.title: Add dye to sample tubes
steps.instruction: Add 199 µL of ONE dsDNA dye solution (QuantiFluor® ONE dsDNA System, 500 rxn, Promega Catalog #E4870) to each sample tube. Bring the dye to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Add DNA samples
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of each DNA sample to the appropriate tube using a P2 pipette for highest accuracy.

steps.title: Mix samples
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube vigorously for 5 seconds, then pulse‑centrifuge briefly to collect the liquid.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Allow all tubes to incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Prepare calibration tubes
steps.instruction: Set up two 0.5 mL tubes, label one ‘Blank’ and the other ‘Standard’. Thaw the Lambda DNA 400 ng/µL standard on ice and add 1 µL to the ‘Standard’ tube.

steps.title: Add dye to calibration tubes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of ONE dsDNA dye solution to both the ‘Blank’ and ‘Standard’ tubes.

steps.title: Mix calibration tubes
steps.instruction: Vortex each calibration tube for 5 seconds and pulse‑centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Incubate calibration tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate the ‘Blank’ and ‘Standard’ tubes at room temperature for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Select assay on instrument
steps.instruction: On the Quantus Fluorometer Home screen, select ‘Protocol’, then choose the ‘ONE DNA’ assay type. If a calibration for ONE DNA has already been performed, you may skip steps 6‑9 and proceed to step 12.

steps.title: Calibrate instrument
steps.instruction: Choose ‘Calibrate’ → ‘ONE DNA’. Place the ‘Blank’ tube in the reader and select ‘Read Blank’. Then place the ‘Standard’ tube and select ‘Read Std’.

steps.title: Set measurement parameters
steps.instruction: On the Home screen, set ‘Sample Volume’ to 1 µL and ‘Units’ to ng/µL.

steps.title: Read first sample
steps.instruction: Load the first sample tube into the reader, close the lid, and the dsDNA concentration is automatically displayed.

steps.title: Read remaining samples
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step for each remaining sample tube until all have been read.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record the displayed dsDNA concentration (ng/µL) for each sample in a spreadsheet or laboratory notebook.
